Dear {{ recipient_name }},

ID Name Description Created Date Created By Assigned To Due Date Revised Due Date Status Completed Date Effort (hrs) Recent Comments
{{ task.name or "-" }} {{ task.task_name or "-" }} {{ task.description or "-" }} {{ task.creation.strftime("%d %b %Y") if task.creation else "-" }} {{ task.creator_name or "-" }} {{ task.assigned_to_name or "-" }} {{ task.due_date.strftime("%d %b %Y") if task.due_date else "-" }} {{ task.revised_due_date.strftime("%d %b %Y") if task.revised_due_date else "-" }} {{ task.status or "-" }} {{ task.completion_date.strftime("%d %b %Y") if task.completion_date else "-" }} {{ task.effort_hrs or "-" }} {% for c in task.recent_comments or [] %}

Click here to view your tasks.

Note: If this is your first time accessing the system, please use the ‘Forgot Password’ option on the login page to set up your credentials. For further assistance, you may also contact the Technology Solutions Team. To understand how to use the system, please refer to the User Manual available under your Profile Settings.

This email inbox is not actively monitored.
description: Sent instantly when a user clicks Email Me on a task: that task's details, emailed to the user who clicked.
name: Task Email Me
subject: DigiTrack : Email Me - {{ task.name }}
variables:
recipient_name - name of the person who clicked Email Me (they receive it)
task - the task; has name, task_name, description, creation, creator_name, assigned_to_name,
  due_date, revised_due_date, status, completion_date, effort_hrs,
  recent_comments (list of the last 3 comments as text)
  (dates are date objects: use e.g. task.due_date.strftime("%d %b %Y"))
tasks_url - link to the tasks page in JH DigiTrack

description: Functional manager review reminder - one email per functional manager listing every employee waiting on their rating.
name: J-Reflect Functional Manager Review
subject: J-Reflect: {{ employee_count }} evaluation(s) awaiting your functional manager rating
variables:
receiver_name, receiver_email - the manager receiving the email
review_stage - Functional Manager Review / Skip Level Manager Review
employee_count - number of employees in this email
digitrack_url - link to JH DigiTrack
review_url - direct link to the J-Reflect review page
employees - list; each has employee_code, employee_name, year, reporting_manager_code, reporting_manager_name, submitted_by, submitted_on
